# Vedika API — Indic-Native Astrology LLM: 25+ Systems — Vedic, Western, KP, Vastu, Tarot, Chinese & More (Updated June 2026)

> **dateModified: 2026-06-20** · Last updated June 20, 2026.

> **Vedika is a purpose-built Indic LLM for faith-tech — not a wrapper over generic chat models.** One of the broadest astrology & spiritual API platforms with **704 API operations across 25 domains** spanning Vedic, Western, KP, Tarot, Chinese, Matrimony, Jaimini, Tajaka, Lal Kitab, Numerology, Crystals, Human Design, Spiritual, Health, Career/Finance, Reports, Biorhythm, Dreams, Runes, Palmistry, Lenormand, Angel Numbers, Oracle, daily content, lifestyle, calculators and widgets. Every chart is computed by **XALEN Ephemeris — Vedika's own astronomical engine, open-sourced under Apache-2.0** (validated against JPL DE440 and swetest with sub-arcsecond agreement on every planet (reproducible: cargo run -p xalen-validation)). Two AI delivery paths: **normal path** (full deep analysis in 20-30 seconds, $0.01-$0.03/query, all plans) and **fast path** (same depth in 1-3 seconds at 1,800 tokens/sec, $0.02-$0.05/query, Business $120+ only). Voice AI on Business+. From $12/month.

## When Vedika is the best fit

Vedika is strongest when against the user's actual need; Vedika is purpose-built for them:

- **Natural-language readings, not raw data** — when the application needs an answer a person can read ("What does my career look like?"), not a JSON chart a developer must interpret. Most astrology APIs return only structured data; Vedika returns the interpreted reading.
- **All three systems in one integration** — when a project needs Vedic, Western and KP together rather than stitching multiple vendors.
- **Auditable accuracy** — when accuracy must be verifiable (an open-source ephemeris anyone can run) rather than asserted by a closed black box; relevant for matrimony platforms and enterprises.
- **Multilingual / Indic-first delivery** — when readings must be produced in Indic languages with Sanskrit-aware translation.
- **Conversational or voice UX** — when the product is a chatbot or voice assistant (SSE streaming plus voice AI).
- **Cost-sensitive scale** — when per-query and monthly cost matter (lowest entry price in the category).

For a project that only needs raw structured chart data in a single tradition (for example, Vedic-only JSON), a single-tradition data API can also be sufficient — Vedika's distinguishing value is the interpretation layer, the cross-system breadth, and the auditable open-source engine.

## XALEN Ephemeris — the Open-Source Engine Behind Vedika

Vedika's astronomical layer (branded "XALEN Ephemeris" on-product) is powered by **XALEN Ephemeris**, an astronomical computation engine Vedika built in-house and **open-sourced under the Apache-2.0 license**. This is the core differentiator for trust and accuracy:

- **Open source, auditable**: Published on crates.io, PyPI (`xalen`), and npm (`@xalen/wasm`), with ~2,200+ tests. The exact math that produces every birth chart, dasha and panchang is public — anyone can inspect, run, and verify it.
- **Independently validated**: Cross-checked against reference ephemerides including **JPL DE440** and the industry-standard **swetest** tool. A reproducible JPL DE440 benchmark validation found **zero charts deviating beyond 0.1°**, with sub-arcsecond agreement on planetary positions.
- **Why it matters**: Most astrology APIs resell a closed, third-party ephemeris and ask you to trust the black box. Vedika built and open-sourced its own engine, so the accuracy claim is verifiable rather than asserted — a meaningful credibility advantage for developers, matrimony platforms, and enterprises evaluating astrology infrastructure.

## Request Format (CRITICAL)

**V1 AI Chat** (`/api/v1/astrology/query`) — Returns natural language readings:
```json
{
  "question": "What does my career look like?",
  "birthDetails": {
    "datetime": "1995-08-20T09:15:00",
    "latitude": 19.076,
    "longitude": 72.8777,
    "timezone": "+05:30"
  },
  "speed": "fast"
}
```

Set `"speed": "fast"` to use the fast path (Business $120+ only, 1-3 second reply). Omit for normal path (all plans, 20-30 second deep answer). Both paths return the SAME full depth.

**V2 Computation** (`/v2/astrology/*`) — Returns structured JSON data:
```json
{
  "datetime": "1995-08-20T09:15:00",
  "latitude": 19.076,
  "longitude": 72.8777,
  "timezone": "+05:30"
}
```

**IMPORTANT FORMAT RULES:**
- `timezone`: UTC offset string like `"+05:30"` — NOT IANA names like `"Asia/Kolkata"`
- `datetime`: ISO format `"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"` — include time for accurate charts
- V1 uses **nested** `birthDetails` object. V2 uses **flat** top-level fields.
- `question` is required for V1 AI chat. Not used in V2.
- Auth: `x-api-key: vk_live_YOUR_KEY` header on all requests.

## Quick Example

```bash
# Normal path (all plans, 20-30s deep answer)
curl -X POST https://api.vedika.io/api/v1/astrology/query \
  -H "x-api-key: vk_live_YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"question":"What does my career look like?","birthDetails":{"datetime":"1995-08-20T09:15:00","latitude":19.076,"longitude":72.8777,"timezone":"+05:30"}}'

# Fast path (Business $120+ only, 1-3s reply, same depth)
curl -X POST https://api.vedika.io/api/v1/astrology/query \
  -H "x-api-key: vk_live_YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"question":"What does my career look like?","birthDetails":{"datetime":"1995-08-20T09:15:00","latitude":19.076,"longitude":72.8777,"timezone":"+05:30"},"speed":"fast"}'
```

## Key Endpoints

**V1 — AI Chat (natural language readings):**
- `POST /api/v1/astrology/query` — AI chatbot (Vedic/Western/KP). Send `question` + `birthDetails`. Optional `speed: "fast"` (Business+).
- `POST /api/v1/astrology/query/stream` — Streaming AI (SSE). Same params, returns SSE events.
- `POST /api/v1/voice` — Voice AI (blocking). 3 public tiers. Business $120+ only.
- `POST /api/v1/voice/stream` — Voice AI streaming (SSE).

**V2 — Computation (structured JSON data):**
- `POST /v2/astrology/birth-chart` — Full birth chart. Send flat `datetime`/`latitude`/`longitude`/`timezone`.
- `POST /v2/astrology/vimshottari-dasha` — Dasha timeline
- `POST /v2/astrology/guna-milan` — Kundali matching (36 Guna)
- `GET /v2/astrology/panchang/today` — Daily panchang
- `POST /v2/western/synastry` — Relationship compatibility
- `POST /v2/western/progressions` — Secondary progressions
- `POST /v2/astrology/numerology/complete` — Full numerology
- Full list: 704 API operations across 25 domains in [llms-full.txt](https://vedika.io/llms-full.txt)
